ucm_acm_faith_fill_empty_tenet_slots_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = { has_variable = ucm_selected_faith_var }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_1
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_2
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_3
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_4
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_5
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_6
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_7
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_8
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_9
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_10
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_11
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_12
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_13
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_14
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_15
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_16
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_17
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_18
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_19
    }
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = {
      add_tenet = tenet_zz_empty_20
    }
  }
}

ucm_acm_faith_clear_empty_tenet_slots_effect = {
